name: cascade-market-intelligence
description: Research markets, evaluate opportunities, and design decision-grade market experiments with source provenance, uncertainty, adversarial analysis, economics, and strict separation between real evidence and synthetic actors.

interface.longDescription: Build current source ledgers for pains, segments, competitors, alternatives, economics, and constraints; score and challenge opportunity hypotheses; and design experiments with success and kill criteria while keeping synthetic personas and simulations out of real-market proof.
defaultPrompt: Research this market with a current evidence ledger.
Evaluate and challenge this market opportunity.
Design a market experiment with success and kill criteria.
